subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the backstage of the shadow-puppet stage taken from Image 1: dark timber frame, red side curtains, red lanterns, a warm blank screen seen from behind, bamboo rods on the left of the booth, a workbench, and human-figure puppets hanging on the right of the booth. It locks the booth only and is not the opening frame.
<Subject 2> is the old puppeteer taken from Image 2: grey hair tied in a topknot, grey goatee, dark-brown robe with a pale inner collar, cloth belt, and a small pouch. The grey studio backdrop is discarded. He stands in profile facing the screen.

summary:
[reference generation] A 5-second 16:9 live-action close-up behind the puppet stage. The camera is already on <Subject 2>'s side profile and does not move. The blank screen sits on the right of the frame. He faces that screen, lets his shoulders sink, and gives a small sigh. He does not look toward the audience.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (background): partially_preserved - timber, red curtain, lantern, and blank screen match Image 1. The wide booth layout is not the opening frame.
<Subject 2> (throughout): fully_preserved - face, hair, and dark-brown robe match Image 2. The lowered-head expression is used, not the smile.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 5-second 16:9 live-action cinematic clip behind an ancient-style puppet stage.
[Shot 1] One continuous take with no cut. It opens already in a side close-up of <Subject 2>'s head and upper body. The camera stays locked. It does not push, pull, or pan.

<Subject 2> is in profile, facing screen-right, toward the warm blank screen. That screen occupies the right side of the frame. He does not turn toward the lens and does not look out at the audience. His shoulders sink. He lets out a small, quiet sigh, chest falling, mouth barely open. His eyes stay lowered toward the lower edge of the screen. He does not smile. His hands stay low and still.

The red lantern light stays warm. No dragon appears. No child appears.
